text: This solution, Insurance and Risk Finance Initiative for Nepal (IRFF) – 2024 Country Diagnostic and Implementation Pathway addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Nepal between Government of Nepal, Public authorities responsible for disaster risk management, financial sector regulation, and insurance policy, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), Nepal’s insurance market stakeholders, Microinsurance channels, and Agriculture insurance entities. The program was implemented in 2024 and focuses on collaboration, accessibility, and raising awareness.
